title: Karbal mein hai wafao'n ka samandar pyasa
body:
REH NAHIN SAKTHA KABHI DEENE PAYAMBER PYASA..
K APNA SAR DEDIYA SHABBIR NE REHKAR PYASA..
DEKHIYE HYDEREY KARRAR NAJAF SE AAKAR...
KARBALA ME HAI wafao'n KA SAMANDAR PYASA..
LAUT KAR AAGAYA JIS DIN SE GHAZANFAR piyasa
Karbala me hai wafao'n ka samandar pyasa.......
Laut kar aagaya jis din se ghazanfar pyasa.....
Karbala me hai wafao'n ka samandar pyasa.......(2)
1)dekhi jaathi nahin allaha re ye tashhnalabi.
Qud Ko is haal me kistarha sanbhale ghaazi.
Qaimaye sibthe payamber me hai asghar pyasa.........................
◦    Karbala me hai wafao'n ka samandar pyasa.......w
2)isse badhkar nahin hosakthi musibath ki ghadi..
Faatha he karbobala par hai qayamath ki ghadi..
Deen par marne chala hai Ali akbar pyasa.....
Karbala me hai wafao'n ka samandar pyasa.......
3)naiza o bhaala o qanjar kabi talwaaro,n me..........
Asre aashoor ghira tanha sitamgaaro,n me..............
Dasht me fathema zehra ka gule tar pyasa............
Karbala me hai wafao'n ka samandar pyasa........
4)baade shabbeer ke shabbeer ka lashkar bankar.......................
Deene ahmad ke liye karne jihaade akbar..
Bar sare shaam chala aabide muztarr pyasa
Karbala me hai wafao'n ka samandar pyasa.......
5)waqte imdaad hai.... imdaad ko aao ghaazi
Bhaayi shabbeer hai mushkil me bachao ghaazi......................
Qoone mazloom ka hai shumre sitamgar pyasa
Karbala me hai wafao'n ka samandar pyasa.......
6)koyi insaan laga sakta nahin andaaza................
Qoob waaqif hai thu is baath se aye karbobala.
Kitne din se tha batha.... shaaha ka lashkar pyasa
Karbala me hai wafao'n ka samandar pyasa.......
7)maqsade zulm Ko mitti me milaane k liye.............
Apne nana ki shariyyath Ko bachaane k liye.........
Haaye duniya,n se chala sibthe payamber pyasa..
Karbala me hai wafao'n ka samandar pyasa.......
8)ghaazi abbas ki hai rab se yahi dill ki dua............
Jaun Ko rozaye shabbeer pa ab jald bula.................
kabb se baithha hai........ shahe dee,n ka suqanwar pyasa.................................
Karbala me hai wafao'n ka samandar pyasa.......
9)hashr me jaun Ko...... pilwaenge paani ghaazi
Nauha qaani ka sila....... denge,n yaqeenan ghaazi
Kaise rehjaaega sarwar... ka suqanwar pyasa..........
Karbala me hai wafao'n ka samandar piyasa
